ruledOut: Treating the compaction Goal facet as a purpose carrier

label: The startup hop carries no purpose: session-prime's fallback surface states only that continuity is recovered on demand from the packet docs, plus two recovery tools.
The Claude pre-compaction transcript analysis emits only Active Files, Recent Topics and Recent Context, reconstructing no why from the packet.
Every runtime adapter follows the same post-compaction shape: summary, Active Spec Folder, optional history lookup and a recovery pointer to /speckit:resume, with no purpose section.
The authored-continuity snapshot's Goal facet is built from next_safe_action, so the injected block labels an imperative action as the goal instead of the packet's purpose.

/speckit:resume emits a resume packet with only now, last, next, blockers and artifact slots, and the same file contradicts itself on whether spec.md is read: one ladder includes it, the priority order and step-2 activities omit it.

/speckit:handoff is the only hop with a purpose-shaped slot: the note format requires a Goal section defined as what the work is for, while prepare only adds a goal_packet pointer when a goal.md can be proven.

/speckit:save writes action and state only: recent_action, next_safe_action, blockers, key_files, completion_pct and question ids, upserted into the leaf document, so a save aimed at a phase parent descends past the parent's Problem & Purpose.
The deep-loop iteration prompt carries a Research Topic, Focus Area and remaining questions but no purpose field; only the free-text topic can carry a why and a caller may pass a bare topic label.

The child-dispatch brief contract requires files and symbols, what was tried, frozen scope and the question, and excludes the preferred conclusion; the packet's problem, purpose and user need appear in neither list.

Net travel of purpose: startup none, compaction none except an action mislabeled Goal, resume no slot and inconsistent spec.md reading, handoff a writer-dependent Goal slot, save none, deep-loop a free-text topic, child brief none.

direction: Treating the compaction Goal facet as a purpose carrier
reason: The code fills the facet from next_safe_action, so the label promises the why and the content supplies an action.
Its output contract has no purpose field, so a full read of spec.md cannot surface one through the resume packet.
